text:
maria: Heads-up — I hit a reproducible hang in the Go SDK generator flow when cancelling a streaming request while a 429 retry happens. sampleapp reproducer attached (small).

kevin: repro steps?

maria: steps:
1) run `./sampleapp gen --stream` against local dev-runtime with 429s injected
2) press Ctrl-C after first token arrives
3) process never exits, goroutine leak.

jia: rough suspicion: our retry middleware ignores ctx.Done() after the first attempt and keeps waiting backoff timer while stream goroutines continue reading from the response body.

sam: can you paste logs / stack?

maria: logs:
```
2026-03-22T14:02:11.123Z INFO gen: started stream request
2026-03-22T14:02:11.456Z WARN http: 429 received, scheduling retry in 500ms
2026-03-22T14:02:12.000Z INFO gen: token chunk: "Hello"
2026-03-22T14:02:12.100Z INFO gen: user cancelled (ctx done)
2026-03-22T14:02:13.000Z INFO retry: backoff waiting (ctx still ignored)
2026-03-22T14:02:15.000Z INFO gen: goroutine reading stream still active
```
stack snippet:
```
created by github.com/redwood/inference/sdk/runtime.(*streamer).start
  /path/to/sdk/streamer.go:142 +0x45
```

kevin: ah — so cancel is observed by the generator code but the retry loop holds a reference that reinstantiates the body reader or blocks shutdown.

jia: probable minimal fix: ensure retry timer and retry loop select on ctx.Done() and return a wrapped error the generator can treat as cancelled, close any response readers, and unregister the stream's read goroutine.

sam: two follow-ups: 1) is this only for 429/backoff case or 5xx too? 2) sampleapp should include a test harness that asserts process exits within 500ms after ctx cancel.

maria: repro currently uses injected 429s but 5xx behaves similarly due to same retry path. I'll add harness.

kevin: for patching, prefer small API-surface change: make retry middleware accept `ctx` and stop waiting when ctx.Done(). If we need to propagate a special error type (e.g., sdk.ErrCancelled) that's fine. Avoid adding global signal handlers.

jia: also check our streaming helper that wraps io.ReadCloser: it should return io.EOF when context cancelled so caller's scanner exits.

maria: opening a PR with a minimal fix + sampleapp test now. PR will: stop retry backoff on ctx, ensure response bodies are closed on early exit, and add test harness.

sam: awesome — assign to eng-runtime and devex to review. @oncall-bot please add a reminder in 24h to check integration tests. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: reminder set — will ping #eng-runtime in 24h if CI still flakes.

kevin: thanks — if you want I can help tidy the test harness.

maria: thanks, I'll request your review in the PR.

sam: one more note for docs: add a short paragraph in the Go SDK troubleshooting guide about cancel semantics with streaming + retries so customers don't copy the bad pattern.

maria: agreed, will include a short blurb in the PR description.

kevin: marking this as a follow-up item in the sprint board.

maria: TL;DR: generator stream + retry backoff can block shutdown — fix in PR to stop waiting on backoff when ctx.Done(), close readers, add sampleapp test, doc blurb.
